title: Google describes a hill-climbing workflow for agent evaluation
dek: The unit of improvement is the complete agent system, not an isolated model score.
evidence: Vendor engineering walkthrough; not independent results
takeaway: Track full traces and per-case outcomes on a frozen regression set. Do not promote a model or prompt change based only on a mean score.

sections.title: What changed

bullets.detail: Google's Agents CLI separates trace generation, grading, run comparisons, failure analysis, and prompt optimization; the unit of evaluation is the tool-using agent, not the model alone.
A system-prompt edit can suppress tool calls and produce unsupported answers while the application code still executes.

paragraphs: Evaluation as a pipeline: Google's Agents CLI separates trace generation, grading, run comparisons, failure analysis, and prompt optimization; the unit of evaluation is the tool-using agent, not the model alone.
Failure mode: A system-prompt edit can suppress tool calls and produce unsupported answers while the application code still executes.

sections.title: Evidence & limits

bullets.detail: Across four test cases, mean response-quality score dropped from 4.00 to 2.75 / 5 after a prompt regression.
Four examples illustrate the regression-detection workflow; they are insufficient to estimate production reliability.

paragraphs: Measured in example: Across four test cases, mean response-quality score dropped from 4.00 to 2.75 / 5 after a prompt regression.
What it does not show: Four examples illustrate the regression-detection workflow; they are insufficient to estimate production reliability.

sections.title: Engineering test

bullets.detail: Freeze representative financial retrieval, numerical reconciliation, citations, entitlement checks, and structured-query tasks.
Compare per-case tool traces, task success, unsupported claims, unauthorized actions, p95 latency, and cost. Reject regressions masked by a stable mean.

paragraphs: Dataset: Freeze representative financial retrieval, numerical reconciliation, citations, entitlement checks, and structured-query tasks.
Release gate: Compare per-case tool traces, task success, unsupported claims, unauthorized actions, p95 latency, and cost. Reject regressions masked by a stable mean.
